answer: Willow-bound task issuance. Each new agent identity must solve a freshly generated task whose parameters derive from a secret seed revealed only after submission, so the solution cannot be precomputed or copied from another agent. A sonnet-shaped audit trail logs each seed-to-solution pair, letting validators confirm the work was unique to that identity. An attacker cannot amortize effort across many identities: every registration forces independent compute, and a delta of even a few percent in reused parameters invalidates the claim.
